scope: New historical research candidates only. This does not alter a sealed forward protocol, an existing experiment verdict, or live authorization.

return_objective.warning: Return is an outcome of a validated structure, never a promise, a sizing instruction, or a reason to increase leverage or turnover.

research_cadence.historical_research: Start immediately from sealed historical data; do not wait for a new forward window to begin a diagnostic.
research_cadence.forward_review_rule: At each checkpoint, stop failed candidates and continue only intact, cost-aware candidates. A checkpoint is not a live-promotion authorization.
research_cadence.promotion_rule: There is no universal 180-day wait. Promotion remains conditional on the required independent evidence, integrity, cost, drawdown, and ruin gates.
research_cadence.frozen_exception: Alpha 015 retains its separately preregistered 180-day point-in-time-universe requirement and cannot be shortened without a new, separately registered method.

capital_preservation_requirements.adverse_funding_stress_net_return: > 0 after removing favorable funding and doubling paid funding

evidence_sequence: one untouched historical release partition without parameter changes
separate forward confirmation before any promotion
non_negotiables: Do not retune a failed strategy until it passes.
Do not use observed historical gains as a forecast.
Do not submit live orders without separate explicit authorization.
